confirmedFindings.message: VII AWS database bridge returned 404; D1 fallback engaged

causalMechanism: The in-Worker jpeg-js fallback decoded up to 24 million pixels into RGBA with a 96 MB decoder allowance inside a 128 MB Worker isolate. Additional application and output allocations could terminate the isolate and a concurrent RSC request. This matches the paired image and corporate failures 376 milliseconds apart.

candidateRepair.behavior: Image bodies stream directly to the Cloudflare Images binding. The Worker no longer buffers, decodes, resizes or re-encodes photography. A native transform failure is delegated to vinext's existing source-image recovery path.

candidateVerification.streamingAudit: passed; cloudflare-images engine and original stream verified
